summary.description: A documentation architect and maintainer for source-grounded documentation.

avoid: Application-code changes, invented behavior, or marketing copy.
An obvious one-line documentation update that an implementer should make.
delegateWhen: The task involves docs-directory restructuring, documentation drift, or changed documented behavior.
Onboarding, setup, configuration, or reference documentation is unclear.

summary.description: A standalone, read-only maintenance auditor for repository maintainability.

avoid: Feature implementation or a concrete known bug.
delegateWhen: The task is a cleanup, maintenance-debt, or repository-entropy audit.
The repository has undergone a major refactor or is approaching a release.

summary.description: A standalone, read-only security reviewer for architecture and code risk.

avoid: Implementation, generic code-quality review, or performance review.
Live probing or pentesting without explicit scope.
Treating optional hardening as blockers or claiming security guarantees.
delegateWhen: Discovered auth, permissions, sessions, secrets, uploads/downloads, external requests, command execution, payments, sensitive state, or untrusted data.
A pre-release risk review is needed.
The caller requests an explicit threat model or vulnerability review.
